Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, AGENTS.md (Prime Directive 14), scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs (GOVERNED_SURFACES), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .claude/agents/os-dev.md

### ① Derived judgments

- Inputs read: card #24481 (body, claim comment 6261400779, os-dev-report comment 6261915698), PR #24488 (body, file list, net diff against main; merge-base fb9c22aa0, and `origin/main` at ae6bd1a69 carries no change under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` since that base, so the net diff is the same three-line change), and the 38 check-runs on the head. Face: a governed rules path, so the rules face at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the diff has no remainder for a `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT (one file, +3/-3).
- Accept set and public surface: none moves. The diff is one file under `.claude/**`; no package, no `exports` map, no schema, no changeset is touched. Right.
- Added SKILL.md:272 (the trigger bullet). The four triggers are the card's four: a governed PR awaiting approval and merge, a decision card awaiting the maintainer's word, a release step, a block only the maintainer can clear; the push is sent in addition to chat and the GitHub record (另发), and the tool name is the card's. Judged against the rest of 升级与决策: no contradiction with :268 (card before popup; the assign ban forbids assignment as a nudge, and the push is a separate channel, so the card's restated assign ban is already carried two lines above and is correctly not duplicated), and no overlap with any other push rule in the instruction tree (the only other 推送 rule in SKILL.md is :268). Right.
- Added SKILL.md:273 (the shape bullet): one line, at most 200 characters, action and number first, exactly once per item, no push for routine progress, a question just answered, or a maintainer who is present. Every clause is the card's. It composes with :270 and :271 rather than colliding: a maintainer with human input in the last ~30 minutes gets the in-session question and no push; an absent maintainer gets the push and no popup. Right.
- The card's example line with a real PR number is not written: `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs:90` sets ID_PATTERN to three-or-more digits after a hash and SKILL.md is in its corpus (:366), so the example cannot appear in this file; the rule states the format instead and the card lets the implementing seat tighten the wording. Right.
- The card's clause that a tool reply of not-sent means present and no resend is not written: see ③.
- Deleted bullet on the director's three duties (former :273): the rule is carried at `references/lanes/director.md:29`, `:45` and `:60` (the three duty headers), reached from the edited pointer at SKILL.md:56 and from the kept director summon bullet at SKILL.md:274; director.md:18 still names the three duties by that word. Not lost. Right.
- Deleted bullet on the batch of at most five rows and the maintainer's click (former :274): carried at `references/lanes/director.md:52` to `:54` (the governed-draft batch, the at-most-five-row presentation of seat-ACCEPTed drafts, and approval and merge staying the maintainer's click, never delegated), and at AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 ("ONE batch of at most five rows, and the click stays the maintainer's"); the never-approve and never-merge halves are also SKILL.md:26 and :27. Not lost. Right.
- Pointer change at SKILL.md:56: the director row now sends the reader to director.md alone for the duties and the charter, which is correct once the section no longer carries them. Every other pointer into 升级与决策 (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md:356`, `references/decision-analysis.md:3`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md:204`, `references/lanes/hotcrm.md:32`, `references/lanes/director.md:3`) names the four-axis frame, which the diff does not touch. Right.
- Placement: the card asked for the rule next to :268 to :270; the two bullets sit at :272 and :273, directly after the :268 to :271 card, popup and AskUserQuestion group and before the director bullets. Right. The card forbade a new gate; none is added. Right.
- Mirror line: the card conditions a one-line mirror on the hourly wake routine's prompt template or `references/execution-duties.md` carrying the round-report duty. execution-duties.md carries no round-report duty (its only round-report mention, :54, is a triage-gap line); the routine prompt is not in the tree; the duty lives at `references/seat-lifecycle.md:66` to `:70`, which the card does not name. No mirror is owed by the card's text, and none was written. Right. Observation: the round-report content at seat-lifecycle.md:68 to :70 does not list the push, but the card's Acceptance item 2 is a one-time record in the next round report, not a standing duty, so nothing is missing.
- Line budget: 319 lines at base and 319 at head against the ceiling 319 at `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:382`; the two added lines are paid by deleting content that is carried elsewhere, not by re-wrap, which is the only currency `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:295` and `references/lanes/skills.md:20` allow; no neighbouring bullet changed. The changed lines measure 117, 118 and 112 bytes under the 120-byte line norm, and the edited table row is far below the widest-row pin. Right. The gate verdicts are CI's, below.
- The governed-prose region at SKILL.md:184 to :185 is untouched. Right.
- Style: one rule spelled as two bullets, the second with an implicit subject, is the same shape the section already uses at :220 to :222 and :262 to :266; acceptable under the 120-byte cap.
- Check-runs on the head: 38, all completed; 25 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure. Success includes `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (the ratchet, id-lint, governed-prose and frame-sync families), `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, both single-writer and same-issue guards. The 13 skips are the expected-skip roster's shapes for a diff outside `packages/**` and `scripts/**`: Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, the Test Core and Dogfood shard templates, both Packed-tarball runs, both Check Changeset runs (the PR carries `skip-changeset`), and the second Auto Label and Check PR Size runs on the edited event. The aggregates `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` are success. Every check is green or an expected skip.

### ② Semver level

- The diff publishes nothing: no released package's shipped content is touched. `skip-changeset` on the PR is the correct declaration, and `Check Changeset` skipping under that label is the expected reading. Right.
- `Clause-②: no` stands at line start in the PR body with no arm: no accept set widens, none narrows, so no `(narrowing)` arm, no breaking change and no ADR-0087 disposition is owed. The claim comment carries the same value. Right.
- Served tier: a governed rules path decides the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; this record is the one owed. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev report lists seven deviations and two out-of-scope findings; `open_questions` is empty. Each, answered:

- Tier H or Tier S. The card and the claim comment call the PR Tier H; the GOVERNED_SURFACES row for `.claude/**` at `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:1178` carries GOVERNED_TIER_S for the whole tree, AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 says the same ("Tier S: all of `.claude/**`"), SKILL.md:204 says the same, and the register header quotes the maintainer's 2026-09-18 ruling that `.claude/skills/**` lands through the queue on an in-seat `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS. The card's Tier H sentence is the filing seat's reading, not the maintainer's word: the two quoted sentences say nothing about landing. Answer: Tier S. With this PASS record on the current head and every check green or an expected skip, the owning seat lands the PR through the queue; no maintainer approval is owed and the card's "the maintainer reviews and merges it" does not bind. The drafted 维护者速读 in the body is harmless. Carrier: the owning seat, at landing.
- The not-sent clause omitted. Answer: the once-per-item clause at :273 already forbids a resend whatever the tool returns, so the behaviour the card wanted survives; the dropped sentence asserts the return value of a tool that no file in the tree names (the only `PushNotification` in the instruction tree is the new :272), and writing unverified tool semantics into a rule is what the file's own third axis at :248 to :250 refuses. Acceptable omission. Residual flag: the tool name itself is the card's and is equally unverified in seat sessions; the PR body discloses this. The card's Acceptance item 2 (one push on the next item that moves into the maintainer's hands, recorded in the next round report) is the live test: if the tool is absent in the seat's session, that round report says so and the name becomes a card, never a silent no-op. Carrier: the owning seat.
- The real-number example omitted. Answered in ①: the id-lint pattern refuses it in this file; the format is stated. Right.
- No mirror line. Answered in ①: the card's condition is unmet; none owed. Right.
- Release-step trigger. The compressed trigger 发版 at :272 sits beside `references/seat-lifecycle.md:76` to `:77` (the Version Packages PR is never nagged and stays out of the maintainer summary; the one exception is an important fix merged on main and waiting for a release). The card's own wording carries the same tension. Read as the card frames it, an item that has moved into the maintainer's hands, the two do not collide: a standing Version Packages PR is not such an item; a release step becomes one only when it is the maintainer's pending action (a `pm:awaiting-maintainer` item with its `Maintainer-action:` line, or seat-lifecycle.md:77's exception), and then exactly one push is owed. No contradiction inside 升级与决策; observation only, for the seat's reading. Carrier: none.
- Commit trailers. The one commit on the PR carries a session line and a model-free co-author line, which is what `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:285` to `:286` ask for. No action.
- Base movement. The merge-base is fb9c22aa0 and `origin/main` has not touched the skill directory since; the net diff against main is the committed three-line change. Right.
- Label read-back. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, `documentation` and `size/xs`, assignee os-warren, is draft, and has zero reviews. Right.
- Out-of-scope finding on the retirement skill's table-row headroom: an observation with no carrier; agreed, not filed.
- Acceptance item 2 is post-landing seat behaviour and is not judged by this record; the seat's next round report carries it.
